slices.focus: Things have been pretty full lately, and I ended up with a small new habit I did
slices.summary: After Shawna slides her a Milwaukee neighborhoods history book at fish fry, Monica discovers that reading about the city without having to fix it is a grounding counterweight to work stress, and deliberately shifts from generic local history to neighborhood-specific books with a separate mystery lane for decompression.
open_loops: Build light reading list with one-line notes per book
Alternate history and mystery books by mood
decisions: Monica started deliberately adding Milwaukee neighborhood history nonfiction to her reading stack during a tense stretch
